chapter: Jules's band and the move north
title: Living with Jimmy Dorsey in New York; Venuti's pit band
summary: Prompted by a Dillingham show, he recalls living on 44th Street in New York while working with Freddie Rich, with Joe Venuti and friends in a theatre pit band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
